αἰάντεσσ: Αἴας — Ajax; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσι, elided (Αἰάντεσσ’ = Αἰάντεσσι; Attic Αἴασι): ’to the Ajaxes’
αἴθρην: αἴθρη — clear sky, bright upper air, fair weather; fem. acc. sg.
βοιώτιος: Βοιώτιος — Boeotian, of Boeotia; adj., masc. nom. sg., in apposition to a name: ’the Boeotian’
βόησαν: βοάω — shout, cry aloud; aor. 3 pl. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἐβόησαν): ’shouted’
γνοίη: γιγνώσκω — come to know, perceive, recognise; aor. opt. 3 sg. act., potential with κε: ’would know’
γράψεν: γράφω — scratch, graze (later ’write’); aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented, ν-movable (= Attic ἔγραψε): ’grazed’
δειλοῖο: δειλός — wretched, miserable, poor; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ), agreeing with a genitive name
εἷός: ἕως (epic εἷος) — until, while; conj., accented εἷός before the enclitic κε, + κε and subj.: ’until’
κάμῃσι: κάμνω — toil, grow weary; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., epic -σι (= Attic κάμῃ), with ἐπεί κε in a general temporal clause: ’when he has grown weary’
κατέχονται: κατέχω — hold down, hold fast, hem in; pres. pass. 3 pl.: ’are held’, with a dative of means
κύψας: κύπτω — bend forward, stoop; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having stooped’
λυγρῆς: λυγρός — bitter, baneful, grievous; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ῆς (= Attic -ᾶς)
λύκτου: Λύκτος — Lyctus, a town (of Crete); fem. gen. sg., after ἐκ: ’from Lyctus’
μάστιε: μαστίζω (epic μαστίω) — whip, lash; pres. imper. 2 sg. act. (= Attic μάστιζε): ’whip!’
μαλθακὸς: μαλθακός — soft, faint-hearted, weak; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’soft’
μείλιχος: μείλιχος — gentle, kind, mild; adj., masc. nom. sg., predicate with εἶναι: ’gentle’
μνησάσθω: μιμνήσκομαι — remember, be mindful of (+ gen.); aor. imper. 3 sg. mid. (ἐμνησάμην): ’let him be mindful of’
νεφέεσσι: νέφος — cloud; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic νέφεσι)
νοστήσαντες: νοστέω — return home; aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having returned home’
ξείνων: ξεῖνος (Attic ξένος) — stranger, guest-friend; masc. gen. pl., partitive after a superlative: ’of all guest-friends’
πεπύσθαι: πυνθάνομαι — learn by inquiry, hear of; perf. inf. mid. dep. (πέπυσμαι), + gen. of the news, in indirect statement: ’to have learned’
ποίησον: ποιέω — make, do; aor. imper. 2 sg. act.: ’make!’
ποδῆν: Ποδῆς — Podes, a companion of Hector (father Eëtion); masc. acc. sg. in -ην, in apposition with ἑταῖρον
πρυμνόν: πρυμνός — hindmost, at the end or base; adj., neut. nom. sg., agreeing with δόρυ; its sense with ὦσε is uncertain (’all the way in’ is a guess)
σκέδασεν: σκεδάννυμι — scatter, disperse; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented, ν-movable (= Attic ἐσκέδασε): ’scattered’
σκέπτεο: σκέπτομαι — look about, look out; pres. imper. 2 sg. mid. dep., epic uncontracted -εο (= Attic σκέπτου): ’look about!’
τίναξε: τινάσσω — shake, brandish; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented (= Attic ἐτίναξε): ’shook’
ταρβήσειεν: ταρβέω — be terrified of, dread (+ acc.); aor. opt. 3 sg. act., potential with κε in a question: ’would be terrified of’
φάει: φάος (φῶς) — light; neut. dat. sg., epic (= Attic φωτί): ’in the light’
φίλῃσι: φίλος — dear; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic φίλαις), agreeing with a feminine plural noun
φαάνθη: φαίνω (mid. φαίνομαι) — show; appear; aor. 3 sg. pass. with mid. sense, epic φαάνθη, unaugmented (= Attic ἐφάνη): ’came into view’
φαίνοπι: Φαίνοψ — Phaenops, a Trojan ally; masc. dat. sg., 3rd-decl., after ἐναλίγκιος: ’to Phaenops’
φραζώμεθα: φράζω (mid. φράζομαι) — plan, consider; pres. subj. mid. 1 pl., hortatory: ’let us plan’
χεῦεν: χέω — pour; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἔχεε; contrast augmented ἔχευε): ’poured’
ἀβυδόθι: Ἄβυδος — Abydus, a town; epic locative in -θι (= Attic ἐν Ἀβύδῳ): ’at Abydus’
ἀκηχέδατ: ἀκαχίζω (perf. ἀκάχημαι, epic ἀκηχέδαται) — distress; perf. mid./pass. be grieved; 3 pl. in -αται, elided (= Attic -ανται); pres. force: ’are grieved’
ἀλεκτρυόνος: Ἀλεκτρυών — Alectryon, a man’s name (the common noun means ’cock’); masc. gen. sg.
ἀπαγγείλειε: ἀπαγγέλλω — report back, announce; aor. opt. act. 3 sg., in a relative clause after a wish: ’who would report’
ἀπονόσφιν: ἀπονόσφιν (also ἀπὸ νόσφιν) — far away, apart; adv. with a verb of motion (no Attic form; χωρίς, ἄπωθεν in sense): ’away’ (ἀπονόσφιν ἔβη ’went away’) · also prep. + gen.: ’far from’
ἀπῶσεν: ἀπωθέω — push away, drive off; aor. 3 sg. act., unaugmented, ν-movable (= Attic ἀπέωσε): ’drove away’
ἀργαλέου: ἀργαλέος — grievous, painful, hard; masc. gen. sg., agreeing with a masc. noun: ’grievous’
ἀσιάδῃ: Ἀσιάδης — son of Asius; masc. dat. sg., patronymic, in apposition with a name: ’son of Asius’
ἀστράψας: ἀστράπτω — flash lightning, lighten; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having lightened’
ἀφήῃ: ἀφίημι — let go, discharge, shoot; aor. subj. 3 sg. act., epic open form (= Attic ἀφῇ), in a general relative clause: ’whoever lets fly’
ἅπτεται: ἅπτω (mid. ἅπτομαι) — fasten; mid. touch, reach (+ gen.); pres. 3 sg. mid.: ’touches, reaches’; a neut. pl. subject takes a sing. verb
ἐγγυάλιξεν: ἐγγυαλίζω — put into the hands of, deliver; aor. 3 sg. act., ν-movable, with κε in a past unreal apodosis: ’would have put into the hands’
ἐνηείης: ἐνηείη — kindness, gentleness; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic -ας), gen. after a verb of remembering: ’of kindness’
ἐπέλαμψε: ἐπιλάμπω — shine upon, shine forth; aor. 3 sg. act., augment inside the compound: ’shone upon’
ἐπιλίγδην: ἐπιλίγδην — grazingly, glancingly; adv. in -δην, epic; a rare word, its sense taken from the verb it goes with
ἐρεθίζων: ἐρεθίζω — provoke, irritate, harass; pres. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’provoking’
ἐτώσια: ἐτώσιος — to no purpose, vain, fruitless; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic, no Attic form (= Attic μάταιος in sense), used as predicate or adverb: ’in vain’
ἐφεσταότος: ἐφίστημι (perf. ἐφέστηκα) — set upon; perf. stand upon; perf. part. act. masc. gen. sg., epic -αότος (= Attic ἐφεστηκότος): ’standing upon’
ἐϋκτιμένης: εὐκτίμενος — well-built, well-founded; fem. gen. sg., epic ἐϋ- (= Attic εὐ-), agreeing with a feminine place-name
ἔλαβεν: λαμβάνω — take, seize; aor. 3 sg. act. (ν-movable)
ἰθύνει: ἰθύνω — make straight, guide straight, steer; pres. 3 sg. act.: ’guides straight’
ὀπάονά: ὀπάων — follower, attendant, comrade; masc. acc. sg., accented ὀπάονά before the enclitic θ’; epic, no Attic form (= Attic ὑπηρέτης in sense)
ὁρμηθέντα: ὁρμάω (pass. ὁρμάομαι) — set in motion; pass. rush, dart forward; aor. part. pass. masc. acc. sg. with mid. sense: ’having rushed’
ὁρόωντες: ὁράω — see, look at; pres. part. masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὁρῶντες)
ὄλεσσον: ὄλλυμι — destroy, ruin; aor. imper. 2 sg. act., epic doubled -σσ- (= Attic ὄλεσον): ’destroy!’
ὑπέτρεσας: ὑποτρέω — shrink in fear before, take fright at (+ acc.); aor. 2 sg. act., augment inside the compound: ’you took fright at’
ῥῦσαι: ῥύομαι — rescue, deliver, protect (distinct from ἐρύω ’drag’); aor. imper. 2 sg. mid.: ’rescue!’

__broaden__.γενώμεθα: γίγνομαι — become, be; aor. subj. 1 pl. mid., after μή in a negative purpose clause: ’lest we become’ · also aor. subj. 1 pl. mid. after αἴ κ’, in a condition: ’if we should become’ (αἴ κ’ ὄφελός τι γενώμεθα ’if we should be of some use’) · also aor. subj. 1 pl. mid. in an indirect question (ὅπως understood from the first clause): ’how we may become’ (χάρμα γενώμεθα ’become a joy’)
__broaden__.εἰπεῖν: εἶπον (aor. of φημί/λέγω) — say, tell; aor. inf. act., completing τέτληκας: ’to speak out, to tell’ · also inf. after ἐπιστάμενος: ’(know how) to speak’ · also aor. inf. after ἀνώγῃ: ’to speak’ (θυμὸς ἀνώγῃ εἰπεῖν ’the heart bids (him) speak’) · also aor. inf. of purpose, after a participle of going: ’to say’ (ἰόντα εἰπεῖν ’going to say’)
__broaden__.κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); with the subj. in purpose and general clauses · also + subj. in a temporal or conditional clause: ’whenever’, ’if’ · also + fut. indic. in a main clause: ’shall’ (κε μελήσεται ’will concern’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (τώ κε … ἠμύσειε ’then would collapse’) · also with an impf. indic., past potential: ’would have’ (κε … ἔπασχον ’I would have suffered’) · also with an aor. indic., past potential: ’would have’ (κε σήκασθεν ’would have been penned’) · also + opt. in a condition after εἰ: ’if … might’ · also εἰς ὅ κε + aor. subj.: ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κε … εὕρωμεν ’until we find’) · also ἤ κε … ἦ κε + subj., in an indirect alternative question: ’whether … or’ · also ὄφρά κε + opt. in a purpose clause after a past tense: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρά κε … θείη ’so that he might make’) · also εἷός κε + subj.: ’until’ (εἷός κε … ἵκηαι ’until you reach’)
__broaden__.λίποιεν: λείπω — leave, leave behind; aor. opt. 3 pl., potential with κεν: ’would leave’ · also aor. opt. 3 pl., in a fear clause after μή: ’lest they leave’ (μή … λίποιεν)
__broaden__.μῆτιν: μῆτις — cunning intelligence, counsel; fem. acc. sg., of respect: ’in counsel’ · also fem. acc. sg., direct object of ὑφαίνειν: ’a plan’ · also object of ἐνίψει: ’cunning’ (νόον καὶ μῆτιν ’mind and cunning’) · also object of τεκτήναιτο: ’(frame) cunning’ · also fem. acc. sg. with διά: ’through the counsel (of)’ (διὰ μῆτιν Ἀθήνης ’through Athena’s counsel’) · also fem. acc. sg., object of ἐνίσποι: ’cunning, counsel’ · also fem. acc. sg., object of φράζομαι: ’the best cunning’ (φραζώμεθα μῆτιν ἀρίστην ’let us plan the best cunning’)
__broaden__.πεδίοιο: πεδίον — plain; neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), gen. of the space traversed: ’over the plain’ · also neut. gen. sg., dependent on a noun: ’of the plain’ · also neut. gen. sg., of separation after ἐκ: ’from the plain’ (ἐκ πεδίοιο)
__broaden__.ποδώκεας: ποδώκης — fleet-footed; adj. of two endings, fem. acc. pl., epic -εας (= Attic -εις), agreeing with the mares · also masc. acc. pl., agreeing with ἵππους: ’fleet-footed (horses)’
__broaden__.σὸν: σός — your, yours (sg.); neut. acc. sg., agreeing with γέρας · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with μένος · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with δέπας: ’your (cup)’ · also neut. nom. sg., agreeing with κλέος: ’your (fame)’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with ἑταῖρον: ’your (companion)’
__broaden__.τοιοῦτον: τοιοῦτος — such, of this kind; masc. acc. sg., predicate with ἐόντα: ’being such a man’ · also masc. acc. sg., object of ἰδέειν: ’such a one’ (τοιοῦτον Ἀχαιῶν ’such a one of the Achaeans’)
__broaden__.φόβοιο: φόβος — flight, panic; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), objective gen. after μήστωρε: ’of flight’ · also masc. gen. sg., after μνήσαντο: ’remembered flight’ · also masc. gen. sg., of respect after ἀδήριτος: ’in flight’ (ἤτ’ ἀλκῆς ἤτε φόβοιο) · also masc. gen. sg., gen. of what is begun, after ἦρχε: ’began the flight’ · also masc. gen. sg. after πρό: ’in the face of flight’ (πρὸ φόβοιο)
__broaden__.ἀγγελίης: ἀγγελίη — message, embassy; fem. gen. sg., Ionic -ης (= Attic -ας), after ἕνεκα · also fem. gen. sg., of the business, with ἤλυθες: ’on a message’ (τευ ἀγγελίης ’on some news’) · also fem. gen. sg., object of πεπύσθαι (gen. of what is learned): ’of the news’
__broaden__.ἄχεος: ἄχος — pain, distress, grief; neut. gen. sg., uncontracted (= Attic ἄχους), of separation: ’from grief’ · also neut. gen. sg., dependent on a noun: ’of grief’ (ἄχεος νεφέλη ’a cloud of grief’)
__broaden__.ἄχρις: ἄχρις — right up to the end, utterly; adv. · also adv. after its noun: ’right up to’ (ὀστέον ἄχρις ’right to the bone’)
__broaden__.ἐρύσσομεν: ἐρύω — draw, drag, haul; aor. subj. 1 pl., epic doubled-σ, short vowel, hortatory: ’let us drag’ · also aor. subj. 1 pl., in an indirect question after ὅπως: ’how we may drag’
__broaden__.ἠέρος: ἀήρ — mist, air; masc. gen. sg., epic ἠέρος (= Attic ἀέρος), after διά: ’through the air’ · also masc. gen. sg., of separation after ὑπό: ’from under the mist’ (ὑπ’ ἠέρος)
